title: How to Manage Multiple Resume Versions (Without Losing Track)
description:
Your resume in Teal isn't one static document — it's a master resume you can spin into as many tailored versions as you need. This video walks through every way to create and manage resume versions in Teal, so you always have the right resume for the right job without starting from a blank page.

You'll see all five paths: a fresh copy from the builder home, starting from a job description with a live match score, starting from a template, generating a cover letter, and creating a version straight from a saved job in your tracker.

 Create a new tailored version from the resume builder home
 Start from a job description and edit against a live match score
 Start from a template in the Designer before touching content
 Generate a cover letter for a specific job
 Build a version straight from a saved job in your tracker
